     private fun wrapText(paint: Paint, text: String, maxW: Int): List<String> {
         val words = text.split(" ")
         val lines = ArrayList<String>()
         var line = StringBuilder()
         for (word in words) {
             val probe = if (line.isEmpty()) word else "$line $word"
             if (paint.measureText(probe) <= maxW) {
                 line = StringBuilder(probe)
             } else {
                 if (line.isNotEmpty()) lines += line.toString()
                 line = StringBuilder(word)

                     var cut = line.length
                     while (cut > 1 && paint.measureText(line.substring(0, cut)) > maxW) cut--

214:             canvas.drawText(btn.label, rect.centerX(), rect.centerY() + dp(4f), btnPaint)
215:         }
216:     }
217: 
218:     private fun drawHandles(canvas: Canvas) {
219:         val hs = dp(16f)
220:         val half = hs / 2
221:         for ((cx, cy) in handlePositions()) {
222:             canvas.drawRect(RectF(cx - half, cy - half, cx + half, cy + half), handlePaint)
223:         }
224:     }
225: 
226:     private fun handlePositions(): List<Pair<Float, Float>> {
227:         val midX = (frame.left + frame.right) / 2
228:         val midY = (frame.top + frame.bottom) / 2
229:         return listOf(
230:             frame.left to frame.top,
231:             midX to frame.top,
232:             frame.right to frame.top,
233:             frame.left to midY,
234:             frame.right to midY,
235:             frame.left to frame.bottom,
236:             midX to frame.bottom,
237:             frame.right to frame.bottom,
238:         )
239:     }
240: 
241:     private fun drawResultPanel(canvas: Canvas) {
242:         val pad = dp(10f)
243:         statusPaint.textAlign = Paint.Align.LEFT
244:         canvas.drawText(
245:             if (scanning) "Распознаю текст…" else statusText.ifBlank { "Готово" },
246:             pad,
247:             panelRect.top + dp(18f),
248:             statusPaint,
249:         )
250:         val maxW = (panelRect.width() - pad * 2).toInt()
251:         val text = resultText
252:         if (text.isNotBlank()) {
253:             val lines = wrapText(resultPaint, text, maxW)
254:             val lineH = resultPaint.textSize * 1.25f
255:             val available = panelRect.height() - dp(34f)
256:             val visible = (available / lineH).toInt().coerceAtLeast(1)
257:             val maxScroll = max(0, lines.size - visible)
258:             scrollLines = scrollLines.coerceIn(0, maxScroll)
259:             var y = panelRect.top + dp(34f) + lineH
260:             for (i in scrollLines until min(scrollLines + visible, lines.size)) {
261:                 canvas.drawText(lines[i], pad, y, resultPaint)
262:                 y += lineH
263:             }
264:         }
265:     }
266: 
267:     private fun wrapText(paint: Paint, text: String, maxW: Int): List<String> {
268:         val words = text.split(" ")
269:         val lines = ArrayList<String>()
270:         var line = StringBuilder()
271:         for (word in words) {
272:             val probe = if (line.isEmpty()) word else "$line $word"
273:             if (paint.measureText(probe) <= maxW) {
274:                 line = StringBuilder(probe)
275:             } else {
276:                 if (line.isNotEmpty()) lines += line.toString()
277:                 line = StringBuilder(word)
278:                 while (line.isNotEmpty() && paint.measureText(line.toString()) > maxW) {
279:                     var cut = line.length
280:                     while (cut > 1 && paint.measureText(line.substring(0, cut)) > maxW) cut--
281:                     lines += line.substring(0, cut)
282:                     line = StringBuilder(line.substring(cut))
283:                 }
284:             }
285:         }
286:         if (line.isNotEmpty()) lines += line.toString()
287:         return lines
288:     }
289: 
290:     override fun onTouchEvent(event: MotionEvent): Boolean {
291:         val x = event.x
292:         val y = event.y
293:         when (event.actionMasked) {
294:             MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> return onDown(x, y)
295:             MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> { onMove(x, y); return true }
296:             MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
297:                 onUp()
298:                 return true
299:             }
300:         }
301:         return true
302:     }
303: 
304:     private fun onDown(x: Float, y: Float): Boolean {
305:         touchX = x
306:         touchY = y
307:         startFrame.set(frame)
308:         lastPanelY = y
309: 
310:         for ((rect, btn) in buttons) {
311:             if (rect.contains(x, y)) {
312:                 pressedBtn = btn
313:                 invalidate()
314:                 return true
315:             }
316:         }
317:         if (panelRect.contains(x, y) && resultText.isNotBlank()) {
318:             mode = Mode.SCROLL
319:             return true
320:         }
321:         val handle = findHandle(x, y)
322:         if (handle != null) {
323:             mode = Mode.CORNER_RESIZE
324:             handleIndex = handle
325:             return true
326:         }
327:         if (frame.contains(x, y)) {
328:             mode = Mode.MOVE
329:             return true
330:         }
331:         return true
332:     }
333: 
334:     private var handleIndex = -1
335: 
336:     private fun findHandle(x: Float, y: Float): Int? {
337:         val r = dp(20f)
338:         for ((i, pos) in handlePositions().withIndex()) {
339:             if (Math.abs(x - pos.first) <= r && Math.abs(y - pos.second) <= r) return i
340:         }
341:         return null
342:     }
343: 
344:     private fun onMove(x: Float, y: Float) {
345:         val dx = x - touchX
346:         val dy = y - touchY
347:         when (mode) {
348:             Mode.MOVE -> {
349:                 val newLeft = startFrame.left + dx
350:                 val newTop = startFrame.top + dy
351:                 val newRight = startFrame.right + dx
352:                 val newBottom = startFrame.bottom + dy
353:                 val shiftX = newLeft.coerceAtLeast(dp(6f)) - newLeft
354:                 val fixedLeft = newLeft + shiftX
355:                 val fixedRight = newRight + shiftX
356:                 frame.set(
357:                     fixedLeft,
358:                     newTop.coerceIn(toolbarRect.bottom + dp(6f), panelRect.top - frame.height() - dp(6f)),
359:                     fixedRight,
360:                     newTop.coerceIn(toolbarRect.bottom + dp(6f), panelRect.top - frame.height() - dp(6f)) + frame.height(),
361:                 )
362:                 invalidate()
363:             }
364:             Mode.CORNER_RESIZE -> {
365:                 resizeTo(dx, dy)
366:                 invalidate()
367:             }
368:             Mode.SCROLL -> {
369:                 val lineH = resultPaint.textSize * 1.25f
370:                 val delta = (y - lastPanelY) / lineH
371:                 scrollLines += delta.toInt()
372:                 lastPanelY = y
373:                 invalidate()
374:             }
375:             else -> Unit
376:         }
377:         touchX = x
378:         touchY = y
379:     }
380: 
381:     private fun resizeTo(dx: Float, dy: Float) {
382:         val minSide = dp(48f)
383:         val l = frame.left
384:         val t = frame.top
385:         val r = frame.right
386:         val b = frame.bottom
387:         when (handleIndex) {
388:             0 -> { val nl = (startFrame.left + dx).coerceAtMost(r - minSide); frame.set(nl, (startFrame.top + dy).coerceAtMost(b - minSide), r, b) }
389:             1 -> frame.set(l, (startFrame.top + dy).coerceAtMost(b - minSide), r, b)
390:             2 -> { val nr = (startFrame.right + dx).coerceAtLeast(l + minSide); frame.set(l, (startFrame.top + dy).coerceAtMost(b - minSide), nr, b) }
391:             3 -> { val nl = (startFrame.left + dx).coerceAtMost(r - minSide); frame.set(nl, t, r, b) }
392:             4 -> { val nr = (startFrame.right + dx).coerceAtLeast(l + minSide); frame.set(l, t, nr, b) }
393:             5 -> { val nl = (startFrame.left + dx).coerceAtMost(r - minSide); val nb = (startFrame.bottom + dy).coerceAtLeast(t + minSide); frame.set(nl, t, r, nb) }
394:             6 -> frame.set(l, t, r, (startFrame.bottom + dy).coerceAtLeast(t + minSide))
395:             7 -> { val nb = (startFrame.bottom + dy).coerceAtLeast(t + minSide); frame.set(l, t, (startFrame.right + dx).coerceAtLeast(l + minSide), nb) }
396:         }
397:         clampFrame()
398:     }
399: 
400:     private fun onUp() {
401:         val btn = pressedBtn
402:         if (btn != null) {
403:             perform(btn)
404:         }
405:         pressedBtn = null
406:         mode = Mode.NONE
407:         callback.onFrameChanged(bean())
408:         invalidate()
409:     }
410: 
411:     private fun perform(btn: Btn) {
412:         when (btn) {
413:             Btn.SCAN -> callback.onScan()
414:             Btn.SPEAK -> callback.onSpeak()
415:             Btn.VOICE -> callback.onCycleVoice()
416:             Btn.OPAQUE -> callback.onOpacity(0.08f)
417:             Btn.HIDE -> callback.onPassThrough()
418:             Btn.EXIT -> callback.onExit()
419:         }
420:     }
421: 
422:     private fun bean(): RectFBean = RectFBean(
423:         left = (frame.left / viewW).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
424:         top = (frame.top / viewH).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
425:         right = (frame.right / viewW).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
426:         bottom = (frame.bottom / viewH).coerceIn(0f, 1f),
427:     )
428: 
429:     fun resetFrame() {
430:         frame.set(viewW * 0.06f, toolbarRect.bottom + dp(24f), viewW * 0.94f, viewW * 0.94f * 0.55f + toolbarRect.bottom)
431:         clampFrame()
432:         invalidate()
433:     }
434: }

315:         val v = overlay ?: return
316:         val lp = overlayParams ?: return

318:             v.visibility = View.INVISIBLE
319:             lp.flags = lp.flags or WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE
320:         } else {
321:             v.visibility = View.VISIBLE
322:             lp.flags = lp.flags and WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE.inv()
323:         }

328:         val currentlyHidden = overlay?.visibility != View.VISIBLE
329:         setPassthrough(!currentlyHidden)

Now let me confirm my findings. Let me summarize the bugs I found:

1. **Panel is always full height (132dp) even when empty** — at launch, a large empty panel covers the bottom. On a high-density device (density 3.0), 132dp = ~400px. Combined with the 44dp toolbar (~132px), that's ~530px of the screen taken at launch with nothing useful. This is the "very much space occupied at startup" bug.

2. **Density-inflated sizes** — dp(44) toolbar and dp(132) panel are hardcoded and scale with density, not screen size. On tablets/high-density, they eat a huge portion.

3. **Inverted shift in MOVE** (OverlayView.kt:353) — dragging left does nothing, dragging right pushes further right. `shiftX = newLeft.coerceAtLeast(dp(6f)) - newLeft` is wrong; when dragging left newLeft < dp(6) so shiftX is positive → moves right. Never allows moving to the left edge. Also only clamps left, right can go off-screen.

4. **resetFrame() broken** (OverlayView.kt:430) — `viewW*0.94f*0.55f` mixes viewW into a Y coordinate, and the frame can extend below the panel. On a tall screen 0.94*1080*0.55 = 558 + toolbar. On landscape it'd be way off. And it ignores the panel top.

5. **Double-dim bug in onDraw** (lines 193, 195) — `drawRect(0, frame.bottom, viewW, viewH)` then `drawRect(frame.left, frame.bottom, frame.right, viewH)` — the second is redundant (fully covered by the first), so that area gets double-dimmed and appears as a darker block. Also lines 191-192/195 overlap regions: `drawRect(0, toolbarRect.bottom, frame.left, frame.top)` and `drawRect(0, toolbarRect.bottom, frame.left, viewH)` overlap on the left side below the frame → double dim. So the dimming is inconsistent — darker on the left and below.

6. **Toolbar drawn with rounded rect but a full-width rect**: `drawRoundRect(toolbarRect, 10dp, 10dp)` with width w and height toolbarH draws rounded corners at all 4 corners, leaving gaps at the very top corners showing undimmed content. Minor.

7. **clampFrame can push the frame below panel** — `bottom = min(frame.bottom, panelRect.top - dp(6f))` then `max(bottom, top + minSide)`; if panel is small, top+minSide could exceed panelRect.top. With minSide = 48dp and a 44dp toolbar + 132dp panel on a short screen (e.g. landscape, height 400px), 48dp=144px > available area. So the frame overflows. Should scale minSide to available space.

8. **Toolbar buttons text may be clipped**: bw = w/6, text size 12sp. "Прозр" fits probably. Fine.

9. `onDown` returns `true` for everything so touch outside the frame is consumed — meaning the underlying app can't be touched. That's by design (bubble toggles passthrough).

10. **SCROLL delta accumulates wrongly** — `scrollLines += delta.toInt()` where delta is fractional: slow drags produce delta=0.4 → toInt()=0 → lastPanelY updated anyway, losing the fraction. So slow scrolling doesn't work at all until a single move exceeds a full line. Real bug.

11. `resultText` is used with the panel, but if `Prefs.autoTts` etc. Not layout related.

12. In the service: `capturePumping` suppresses onDraw, so during scanning the overlay appears blank (just an empty transparent window). It's restored. Fine-ish.

13. **The scan region uses `Prefs.frame()` (saved prefs) instead of the live overlay frame.** OverlayView's `frame` is only persisted to prefs in `onUp` (onFrameChanged). That's mostly consistent. But if scan is triggered by a button press, onUp → onFrameChanged happens... wait: `perform(btn)` is called BEFORE `callback.onFrameChanged(bean())` in onUp (line 403 then 407). So `onScan()` runs first, reads stale Prefs.frame(), then the frame is saved. That means a scan right after resizing the frame captures the OLD region. That's a real ordering bug! Should save frame before performing the action.

That explains a lot: the user moves the frame, presses Scan, and the capture is of the old region. And the user said "много пространства занято" — well, mostly the layout issue.

Let me now check the git log to see recent overlay work and check whether there are tests.

Let me prioritize the fixes that address "too much space at launch":

**Primary fix**: dynamic panel height — panel collapses to a thin status strip when there's no result, expands only when text exists, and all sizes are clamped to a fraction of the screen height instead of raw dp.

Let me write the fix. Plan:

1. `layoutMetrics`: compute toolbar height as `min(dp(44), h*0.06)`, panel height dynamically from state; store as `panelH` field; recompute on size change and when result text changes.
2. Add `recomputePanel()` that sets panelRect based on whether resultText is blank, then clampFrame().
3. `clampFrame`: minSide = min(dp(48), available/3).
4. Fix MOVE clamping.
5. Fix resetFrame.
6. Fix dim overlap.
7. Fix SCROLL fractional accumulation.
8. Fix onUp ordering (save frame before perform).
9. Draw panels with proper rounding (only inner corners) — use a path or just draw a plain rect for toolbar/panel, or round only bottom corners of toolbar and top corners of panel. Simpler: use Path with per-corner radii. Let me implement a small helper `roundedRectPath(rect, tl, tr, br, bl)`.

Let me check git log first, and also see if there is a way to run tests/lint.

The `overlay-reader` standalone module is the one. Now let me implement the fixes.

Let me plan the todo list and implement.

Key fixes to OverlayView.kt:
1. Toolbar/panel heights clamped to screen fraction; panel collapses when no text.
2. Fix MOVE drag clamping (inverted shift + no right clamp).
3. Fix resetFrame math.
4. Fix double-dimmed regions.
5. Fix fractional scroll accumulation.
6. minSide scaled to available space.
7. Rounded corners only on inner corners so no undimmed gaps.

And OverlayReaderService.kt: save the frame before performing the button action.

Let me write the code.

For the panel: needs to be recomputed when resultText changes. I'll add a `setResult(text: String)` method or make the panel height computed in onDraw. Cleanest: make `resultText` a property with a custom setter that recomputes the panel.

```kotlin
var resultText: String = ""
    set(value) {
        if (field == value) return
        field = value
        scrollLines = 0
        layoutPanel()
        clampFrame()
        invalidate()
    }
```

But `layoutPanel` needs viewH which is set in layoutMetrics. Guard for 0.

Let me restructure:

```kotlin
private var viewH = 0f
private var viewW = 0f

private var toolbarH = 0f
private val panelExpandedH get() = ...
```

Implement:

```kotlin
private val maxPanelH: Float get() = min(dp(132f), viewH * 0.28f)
private val minPanelH: Float get() = min(dp(30f), viewH * 0.08f)

private fun layoutPanel() {
    if (viewH <= 0f) return
    val h = if (resultText.isBlank()) minPanelH else maxPanelH
    panelRect = RectF(0f, viewH - h, viewW, viewH)
}
```

And `layoutMetrics` sets toolbarH with a cap and calls layoutPanel.

```kotlin
private fun layoutMetrics(w: Float, h: Float) {
    viewW = w
    viewH = h
    toolbarH = min(dp(44f), h * 0.07f)
    toolbarRect = RectF(0f, 0f, w, toolbarH)
    layoutPanel()
    ...
}
```

clampFrame:
```kotlin
private fun clampFrame() {
    val top = toolbarRect.bottom + dp(6f)
    val bottomLimit = panelRect.top - dp(6f)
    val minSide = min(dp(48f), max(dp(24f), (bottomLimit - top) * 0.6f))
    ...
}
```

Hmm careful: if available space is small, minSide must be < available. `min(dp(48), (bottomLimit-top))` clamped to at least some px. Let me do:

```kotlin
val available = (panelRect.top - dp(6f)) - (toolbarRect.bottom + dp(6f))
val minSide = max(dp(16f), min(dp(48f), available * 0.5f))
```

If available is negative (tiny screen), max(dp(16), negative) = dp(16), which could still overflow. Add final safety: if available <= 0, set frame to the full available area (or hide). Let's clamp top/bottom strictly:

```kotlin
val l = min(max(frame.left, dp(6f)), viewW - dp(6f))
val t = min(max(frame.top, toolbarRect.bottom + dp(6f)), panelRect.top - dp(6f))
```
and then enforce minSide only if it fits:

fun resetFrame() {
        val boxTop = toolbarRect.bottom + dp(10f)
        val boxBottom = panelRect.top - dp(10f)
        val boxH = max(dp(48f), boxBottom - boxTop)
        val left = min(viewW * 0.06f, viewW - dp(6f))
        // Высота рамки считалась от viewW, а не от viewH, — в альбомной
        // ориентации уезжала далеко за нижнюю панель.
        val top = min(boxTop + boxH * 0.1f, boxBottom)
        val right = max(min(viewW * 0.94f, viewW - dp(6f)), left)
        val bottom = max(min(top + boxH * 0.55f, boxBottom), top)
        frame.set(left, top, right, bottom)
        clampFrame()
        invalidate()
    }

249:         if (rect == null) {
250:             toast("Сначала задайте область рамки")
251:             return
252:         }
253:         if (!OverlayGestureService.isEnabled()) {
254:             toast("Включите Службу доступности, чтобы листать самому")
255:         }
256:         stopReading()
257:         readProjection = projection
258:         val engine = OverlayCaptureEngine(applicationContext, projection)
259:         capture = engine
260:         val reader = OverlayAutoReader(applicationContext, engine)
261:         autoReader = reader
262:         readJob = reader.start(
263:             scope = serviceScope,
264:             region = rect,
265:             onPage = { text -> uiHandler.post { setBubble(text) } },
266:             onNote = { note ->
267:                 uiHandler.post {
268:                     setBubble(note)
269:                     readButton?.text = if (isReading) "⏹" else "▶"
270:                     readButton?.setBackgroundColor((if (isReading) PRIMARY_ACTIVE_BG else BTN_BG).toInt())
271:                     readRowLabel?.text = if (isReading) "Стоп-чтение" else "Читать рамку"
272:                 }
273:             },
274:         )
275:         toast("Чтение: ${reader.engineTitle()}")
276:     }

279:         readJob?.cancel()

281:         runCatching { capture?.stop() }
282:         capture = null
283:         runCatching { readProjection?.stop() }
284:         readProjection = null
285:         autoReader = null
286:         runCatching { readEngine.stop() }

302:     override fun onStartCommand(intent: Intent?, flags: Int, startId: Int): Int {
303:         if (!canDrawOverlays(this)) {
304:             stopSelf()
305:             return START_NOT_STICKY
306:         }
307:         ensureForeground()
308:         if (root == null) buildOverlay()
309:         when (intent?.action) {
310:             ACTION_SPEAK -> {
311:                 val text = intent.getStringExtra(EXTRA_TEXT).orEmpty()
312:                 if (text.isNotBlank()) {
313:                     expandNow()
314:                     speakText(text)
315:                 }
316:             }
317:             ACTION_STT_START -> toggleStt(force = true)
318:             ACTION_STT_STOP -> toggleStt(force = false)
319:             ACTION_SELECT_REGION -> {
320:                 expandNow()
321:                 openSelector()
322:             }
323:             ACTION_REFRESH -> {
324:                 applyClipboardWatch()
325:                 applyFrame()
326:             }
327:             ACTION_START_READING -> {
328:                 val code = intent.getIntExtra(EXTRA_RESULT_CODE, 0)
329:                 val data: Intent? = intent.getParcelableExtra(EXTRA_RESULT_DATA)
330:                 if (data == null) {
331:                     toast("Разрешение на захват не получено")
332:                 } else {
333:                     val projection = runCatching {
334:                         val mpm = getSystemService(Context.MEDIA_PROJECTION_SERVICE)
335:                             as android.media.projection.MediaProjectionManager
336:                         mpm.getMediaProjection(code, data)
337:                     }.getOrNull()
338:                     if (projection == null) {
339:                         toast("Не удалось начать захват экрана")
340:                     } else {
341:                         startReading(projection)
342:                     }
343:                 }
344:             }
345:         }
346:         applyClipboardWatch()
347:         applyFrame()
348:         // Панель не должна висеть поверх наших собственных настроек и
349:         // читалки: раньше оверлей рисовался поверх приложения, открывшего
350:         // его, и полупрозрачная панель лежала на экране поверх текста.
351:         startForegroundWatcher()
352:         return START_STICKY
353:     }

355:     private val foregroundHandler = Handler(Looper.getMainLooper())
356:     private val foregroundCheck = object : Runnable {
357:         override fun run() {
358:             applyForegroundVisibility()
359:             foregroundHandler.postDelayed(this, FOREGROUND_POLL_MS)
360:         }
361:     }
362: 
363:     private fun startForegroundWatcher() {
364:         foregroundHandler.removeCallbacks(foregroundCheck)
365:         foregroundHandler.post(foregroundCheck)
366:     }

368:     /**
369:      * Прячет панель, пока на экране само приложение.
370:      *
371:      * Сверху окна с разрешением SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW не спрятать наше
372:      * собственное окно нельзя, но можно не рисовать панель поверх него:
373:      * иначе настройки оверлея открывались поверх самих себя.
374:      */
375:     private fun applyForegroundVisibility() {
376:         val rootView = root ?: return
377:         val foreground = runCatching {
378:             val usage = getSystemService("usage") as? UsageStatsManager
379:             val now = System.currentTimeMillis()
380:             val app = usage?.queryUsageStats(UsageStatsManager.INTERVAL_BEST, now - 3_600_000, now)
381:                 ?.maxByOrNull { it.lastTimeUsed }
382:             val inForeground = app != null &&
383:                 app.lastTimeUsed > now - 2_000 &&
384:                 packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(app.packageName)
385:                     ?.component?.packageName == packageName
386:             inForeground
387:         }.getOrDefault(false)
388: 
389:         if (foreground) {
390:             if (rootView.visibility != View.GONE) {
391:                 rootView.visibility = View.GONE
392:             }
393:         } else if (rootView.visibility != View.VISIBLE) {
394:             rootView.visibility = View.VISIBLE
395:         }
396:     }
397: 
398:     private fun ensureForeground() {
399:         val nm = getSystemService(Context.NOTIFICATION_SERVICE) as NotificationManager
400:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
401:             nm.createNotificationChannel(
402:                 NotificationChannel(CHANNEL_ID, "OCR-оверлей", NotificationManager.IMPORTANCE_LOW),
403:             )
404:         }
405:         val launch = packageManager.getLaunchIntentForPackage(packageName)
406:         val contentIntent = launch?.let {
407:             PendingIntent.getActivity(
408:                 this,
409:                 0,
410:                 it,
411:                 PendingIntent.FLAG_IMMUTABLE or PendingIntent.FLAG_UPDATE_CURRENT,
412:             )
413:         }
414:         val builder = if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.O) {
415:             Notification.Builder(this, CHANNEL_ID)
416:         } else {
417:             @Suppress("DEPRECATION")
418:             Notification.Builder(this)
419:         }
420:         val b = builder
421:             .setContentTitle("OCR-кнопка")
422:             .setContentText("Плавающая кнопка поверх приложений")
423:             .setSmallIcon(android.R.drawable.ic_menu_view)
424:             .setOngoing(true)
425:         if (contentIntent != null) b.setContentIntent(contentIntent)
426:         if (Build.VERSION.SDK_INT >= Build.VERSION_CODES.Q) {
427:             // Тип mediaProjection обязателен: без него на Android 14+ система
428:             // не отдаст MediaProjection и захват рамки не запустится.
429:             startForeground(
430:                 NOTIF_ID,
431:                 b.build(),
432:                 ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PLAYBACK or
433:                     ServiceInfo.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_TYPE_MEDIA_PROJECTION,
434:             )
435:         } else {
436:             startForeground(NOTIF_ID, b.build())
437:         }
438:     }

536:     private fun applyClipboardWatch() {

538:         clipListener?.let { runCatching { cm.removePrimaryClipChangedListener(it) } }
539:         clipListener = null

541:         val listener = ClipboardManager.OnPrimaryClipChangedListener {

549:         }
550:         clipListener = listener
551:         cm.addPrimaryClipChangedListener(listener)

594:     private fun parseRegion(): Region? {
595:         val parts = prefs.overlayFixedRegion().get().split(',').mapNotNull { it.toFloatOrNull() }
596:         if (parts.size != 4) return null
597:         val (l, t, r, b) = parts
598:         if (!(l in 0f..1f && t in 0f..1f && r in 0f..1f && b in 0f..1f && l < r && t < b)) return null
599:         return Region(l, t, r, b)
600:     }

632:     /** Полноэкранный селектор: потяните пальцем прямоугольник области. */
633:     private fun openSelector() {
634:         if (selectorRoot != null) return
635:         val dm = resources.displayMetrics
636:         val layout = FrameLayout(this)
637:         layout.setBackgroundColor(0x88000000.toInt())
638:         val draw = RegionDrawView(this)
639:         layout.addView(draw, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT))
640:         selectorDraw = draw
641: 
642:         val hint = TextView(this)
643:         hint.text = "Выделите область пальцем • тап — отмена"
644:         hint.setTextColor(0xFFFFFFFF.toInt())
645:         hint.textSize = 14f
646:         hint.gravity = Gravity.CENTER
647:         hint.setPadding(0, dp(48f), 0, 0)
648:         layout.addView(hint, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.WRAP_CONTENT, Gravity.TOP))
649: 
650:         var downX = 0f
651:         var downY = 0f
652:         var moved = false
653:         layout.setOnTouchListener { _, event ->
654:             when (event.actionMasked) {
655:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_DOWN -> {
656:                     downX = event.rawX
657:                     downY = event.rawY
658:                     moved = false
659:                     draw.setRect(downX, downY, downX, downY)
660:                     true
661:                 }
662:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_MOVE -> {
663:                     moved = true
664:                     draw.setRect(downX, downY, event.rawX, event.rawY)
665:                     true
666:                 }
667:                 MotionEvent.ACTION_UP, MotionEvent.ACTION_CANCEL -> {
668:                     if (!moved) {
669:                         closeSelector()
670:                     } else {
671:                         val r = draw.normalized(dm.widthPixels, dm.heightPixels)
672:                         if (r != null) {
673:                             prefs.overlayFixedRegion().set("${r.l},${r.t},${r.r},${r.b}")
674:                             prefs.overlayRegionMode().set("fixed")
675:                             updateRegionButton()
676:                             toast("Область зафиксирована")
677:                         }
678:                         closeSelector()
679:                         applyFrame()
680:                     }
681:                     true
682:                 }
683:                 else -> false
684:             }
685:         }
686: 
687:         val windowType = overlayType()
688:         val p = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
689:             ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
690:             ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT,
691:             windowType,
692:             WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
693:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
694:             PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
695:         )
696:         selectorRoot = layout
697:         runCatching { wm.addView(layout, p) }.onFailure {
698:             selectorRoot = null
699:             toast("Не удалось открыть выбор области")
700:         }
701:     }

703:     private fun closeSelector() {
704:         selectorRoot?.let { runCatching { wm.removeView(it) } }
705:         selectorRoot = null
706:         selectorDraw = null
707:     }

709:     /** Рамка зафиксированной области: тонкие границы, клики — сквозь. */
710:     private fun applyFrame() {
711:         val show = prefs.overlayShowFrame().get() &&
712:             prefs.overlayRegionMode().get() == "fixed" &&
713:             parseRegion() != null
714:         if (!show) {
715:             frameRoot?.let { runCatching { wm.removeView(it) } }
716:             frameRoot = null
717:             frameParams = null
718:             return
719:         }
720:         val region = parseRegion() ?: return
721:         val dm = resources.displayMetrics
722:         val x = (region.l * dm.widthPixels).toInt()
723:         val y = (region.t * dm.heightPixels).toInt()
724:         val w = ((region.r - region.l) * dm.widthPixels).toInt().coerceAtLeast(dp(24f))
725:         val h = ((region.b - region.t) * dm.heightPixels).toInt().coerceAtLeast(dp(24f))
726:         val thickness = dp(3f)
727:         val color = 0xFF4A7EAF.toInt()
728: 
729:         val box = FrameLayout(this)
730:         fun border(wPx: Int, hPx: Int, gravity: Int): View {
731:             val v = View(this)
732:             v.setBackgroundColor(color)
733:             box.addView(v, FrameLayout.LayoutParams(wPx, hPx, gravity))
734:             return v
735:         }
736:         border(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, thickness, Gravity.TOP)
737:         border(ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, thickness, Gravity.BOTTOM)
738:         border(thickness, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, Gravity.START)
739:         border(thickness, ViewGroup.LayoutParams.MATCH_PARENT, Gravity.END)
740: 
741:         val existing = frameRoot
742:         if (existing != null && frameParams != null) {
743:             frameParams!!.x = x
744:             frameParams!!.y = y
745:             frameParams!!.width = w
746:             frameParams!!.height = h
747:             frameRoot = box
748:             runCatching {
749:                 wm.removeView(existing)
750:                 wm.addView(box, frameParams!!)
751:             }.onFailure {
752:                 frameRoot = null
753:                 frameParams = null
754:             }
755:             return
756:         }
757:         val p = WindowManager.LayoutParams(
758:             w,
759:             h,
760:             overlayType(),
761:             WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE or
762:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_NOT_TOUCHABLE or
763:                 WindowManager.LayoutParams.FLAG_LAYOUT_IN_SCREEN,
764:             PixelFormat.TRANSLUCENT,
765:         )
766:         p.gravity = Gravity.TOP or Gravity.START
767:         p.x = x
768:         p.y = y
769:         frameRoot = box
770:         frameParams = p
771:         runCatching { wm.addView(box, p) }.onFailure {
772:             frameRoot = null
773:             frameParams = null
774:         }
775:     }

779:         applyFrame()
780:         toast(if (prefs.overlayShowFrame().get()) "Рамка показана" else "Рамка скрыта")
781:     }

794:     private fun buildOverlay() {
795:         expandedW = dp(BASE_W_DP)

797: 
798:         val layout = FrameLayout(this)

800:         // ===== Развёрнутая панель: как меню читалки, а не «экран» =====
801:         val content = LinearLayout(this)

803:         // Панель лежит поверх чужого приложения, и её фон обязан быть
804:         // непрозрачным: раньше он был 0xF2 (95%), и сквозь него отлично
805:         // читался текст игры — надписи панели сливались с чужими, и
806:         // разобрать, где чьё, было невозможно. Светлый текст даже 5%
807:         // просвечивания давали читаемую картинку.
808:         content.background = rounded(CARD_BG, CARD_RADIUS_DP)
809:         content.setPadding(dp(6f), dp(4f), dp(6f), dp(6f))
810: 
811:         val header = LinearLayout(this)
812:         header.orientation = LinearLayout.HORIZONTAL
813:         header.gravity = Gravity.CENTER_VERTICAL
814:         val handle = TextView(this)
815:         handle.text = "≡ "
816:         handle.textSize = 14f

So `OcrOverlayService.kt` in the MAIN app is a classic-Views based overlay service, but the labels there are different from the ones the user described ("OCR скан", "Автопрокрутка", "Читать страницу", "Стоп чтения", "Скриншот сейчас", "Значки озвучки: вкл", "Манхва · ↓ Сверху вниз", "AI-чат", "Голос: авто").

Hmm, those labels sound like they're in a settings screen or a different overlay panel. Let me search for those specific Russian strings.

Also there's `MiniOverlayService.kt` in webbrowser, and `OverlayGestureService.kt`. And `OcrOverlaySettingsScreen.kt`.

Let me search for the Russian labels.

42:         private set

46:     /** Захватить текущий кадр и вернуть битмап области [rect] (в экранных px). */
47:     fun capture(rect: Rect): Bitmap? {
48:         if (display == null && !ensureStarted()) return null
49: 
50:         // Статичный экран может долго не порождать новых кадров (AUTO_MIRROR
51:         // отрисовывает только «грязные» области) — крутимся до 3 секунд.
52:         val succeedAt = System.currentTimeMillis() + 3000
53:         var image: android.media.Image? = null
54:         while (image == null && System.currentTimeMillis() < succeedAt) {
55:             image = reader?.acquireLatestImage()
56:             if (image == null) Thread.sleep(120)
57:         }
58:         val img = image ?: return null
59:         return try {
60:             val full = copyImage(img) ?: return null
61:             try {
62:                 val left = rect.left.coerceIn(0, full.width - 1)
63:                 val top = rect.top.coerceIn(0, full.height - 1)
64:                 val right = rect.right.coerceIn(left + 1, full.width)
65:                 val bottom = rect.bottom.coerceIn(top + 1, full.height)
66:                 Bitmap.createBitmap(full, left, top, right - left, bottom - top)
67:             } finally {
68:                 if (!full.isRecycled) full.recycle()
69:             }
70:         } finally {
71:             img.close()
72:         }
73:     }

101:                 sizeW,
102:                 sizeH,
103:                 density,
104:                 DisplayManager.VIRTUAL_DISPLAY_FLAG_AUTO_MIRROR,
105:                 reader!!.surface,
106:                 null,
107:                 handler,
108:             )
109:         } catch (e: Exception) {
110:             Log.e("YomikaiOverlayCapture", "createVirtualDisplay failed", e)
111:             null
112:         }
113:         if (display == null) {
114:             // Чистим за собой, чтобы следующий capture() честно попробовал снова.
115:             releaseCaptureResources()
116:         }
117:         return display != null
118:     }

120:     /**
121:      * Гасит только собственные ресурсы захвата. MediaProjection не трогаем:
122:      * она принадлежит сервису, и её остановка погасила бы всю сессию.
123:      */
124:     private fun releaseCaptureResources() {
125:         runCatching { display?.release() }
126:         runCatching { reader?.close() }
127:         display = null
128:         reader = null
129:         handler?.looper?.quitSafely()
130:         thread?.join(500)
131:         thread = null
132:         handler = null
133:     }
134: 
135:     private fun copyImage(image: android.media.Image): Bitmap? {
136:         val plane = image.planes[0]
137:         val buffer = plane.buffer
138:         val pixelStride = plane.pixelStride
139:         val rowStride = plane.rowStride
140:         val rowPadding = rowStride - pixelStride * image.width
141:         if (rowPadding < 0) return null
142: 
143:         val aux = Bitmap.createBitmap(
144:             image.width + rowPadding / pixelStride,
145:             image.height,
146:             Bitmap.Config.ARGB_8888,
147:         )
148:         aux.copyPixelsFromBuffer(buffer)
149:         val bmp = Bitmap.createBitmap(aux, 0, 0, image.width, image.height)
150:         if (!aux.isRecycled) aux.recycle()
151:         return bmp
152:     }

## 4. UI framework answer

- **System floating OCR overlay panel (`OcrOverlayService`) → classic Android Views**, programmatically constructed (no XML layout). `FrameLayout` / `LinearLayout` / `TextView` / `EditText` / `Button`, backgrounds via `GradientDrawable`. No `ComposeView`, no `setContent {}` anywhere in `ui/overlay/` (verified by grep). Colors are hard-coded ARGB ints, not Material theme.
- **The panel with the `OCR скан` / `Автопрокрутка` / `AI-чат` / `Голос: авто` rows (`ReaderFloatingControls`) → Jetpack Compose + Material 3** (`Card`, `SmallFloatingActionButton`, `FloatingActionButton`, `AnimatedVisibility`, `detectDragGestures`), rendered inside `ReaderActivity`'s Compose tree — **not** a WindowManager window, so it only exists while the reader activity is in the foreground.
- `MiniOverlayService` → classic Views.
- `OcrResultOverlay` / `OcrResultPopup` / `OcrResultBottomSheet` / `OcrSelectionOverlay` / `OcrBubbleVoiceOverlay` / `ReaderContentOverlay` / `OcrLoadingIndicator` → Compose.
- `ReaderOcrOverlayRenderer` / `ReaderPageImageView` OCR bubble drawing → classic Canvas/`Paint` on the page view.

## 5. Notable negatives (verified by grep, main app only)

- No `overlayOpacity` preference/identifier exists anywhere.
- `OcrPreferences.ocrOverlayCompact()` (`pref_ocr_overlay_compact`, `OcrPreferences.kt:348`) is declared but has **zero usages**.
- The OCR bubble overlay panel has **no opacity/transparency user setting** — only `MiniOverlayService` has the `chromeAlpha` slider.
